in_marathi.name: Harishankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Hari + Shankara (Lord of the mountains)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harishankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harishankar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Hari and Shankara. Hari means 'God' and Shankara means 'Lord of the mountains'. Thus, Harishankar is a name that represents the divine power of God, who is also considered the Lord of all mountains.
